messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: y_vaSUNBRVA2AbfFs1EOEQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "y_vaSUNBRVA2AbfFs1EOEQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",

  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],

    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",

    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: A rescue begins at the edge of a broken city.
scenes.visual_description: On a cracked hilltop overlooking a ruined royal city at dusk, a mapmaker unrolls a charred map while a small metal fox sniffs the wind.

scenes.caption: The lamp wakes with a warning.
scenes.visual_description: An oil lamp with a single glowing eye in its flame floats above the map, casting long shadows across torn royal banners stuck to a fence post.

scenes.caption: A reflection steps out of a puddle.
scenes.visual_description: From a rain puddle in the road, a figure in a clear diving helmet rises, coat shimmering with reflected city lights and falling embers.

scenes.caption: They approach the silent castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron castle gates hang half-open under a smoke-orange sky; the clockwork fox creeps ahead while the mapmaker checks her brass compass.

scenes.caption: An official sleeps through the alarm bells.
scenes.visual_description: Just inside the gate, a plump official slumps against a pillar using a ledger book as a pillow, stamped papers fluttering on his sleeves as bells ring overhead.

scenes.caption: The lamp warns of a cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower wreathed in green mist looms above a courtyard; the oracle lamp's flame-eye narrows toward it as the mapmaker raises a hand to halt.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a great winged beast circle overhead.
scenes.visual_description: An enormous shadow with spread wings sweeps across torn banners and broken rooftops; the diver pulls the mapmaker into the shelter of a doorway.

scenes.caption: The fox finds a hidden mirror passage.
scenes.visual_description: In a collapsed parlor, the clockwork fox paws at a tall cracked mirror that ripples like water, its blue glass eyes reflecting the glow.

scenes.caption: The diver slips through the glass to scout.
scenes.visual_description: Half-submerged in the mirror's silver surface, the diver in the clear helmet waves back at the mapmaker, who sketches the room on a fresh map.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols march past the broken fountain.
scenes.visual_description: From behind a toppled statue, the mapmaker and fox watch lines of empty animated armor clank past a dry fountain choked with old royal banners.

scenes.caption: Frightened faces peer from shuttered windows.
scenes.visual_description: A narrow alley of tall houses, pale faces just visible behind cracked shutters; the oracle lamp dims its eye to a polite spark so it will not betray them.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a true name.
scenes.visual_description: A stone door carved with shifting runes blocks a stairwell; glowing letters drift in the air while the fox tilts its head and the diver presses a gloved palm to the stone.

scenes.caption: The lamp whispers the answer.
scenes.visual_description: The oracle lamp tips toward the door, the flame-eye stretching into a word-shape; runes click open like turning gears as warm light spills onto the steps.

scenes.caption: They find the lost one in a glass cell.
scenes.visual_description: In a vaulted chamber, a small figure curled inside a hanging glass sphere; the official is also there, snoring upright, ledger papers fused to a nearby pillar.

scenes.caption: The diver swims up through the sphere to free them.
scenes.visual_description: The diver dives upward into the glass sphere as though it were a pond, coat rippling with reflected lanterns while the fox keeps watch by the doorway.

scenes.caption: Alarms wake even the sleepiest official.
scenes.visual_description: Red light floods the corridor; the official stumbles awake clutching his ledger pillow as the mapmaker drags him along by the sleeve, papers trailing.

scenes.caption: They race for the long bridge out of the city.
scenes.visual_description: A narrow stone bridge stretches over a black river; the fox sprints ahead, the diver carries the rescued figure, and the mapmaker shoves the official forward under a sky full of sparks.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far shore, the lamp blinks one last warning.
scenes.visual_description: On a misty riverbank beyond the ruined skyline, the group rests on mossy stones; the oracle lamp's eye glows softly while the fox winds its own key-tail.
